headline_marked: [[Jensen Huang and Lisa Su omitted]] from TIME’s 2026 ‘Architects of AI’ list, while Paris Hilton makes it
headline: Jensen Huang and Lisa Su omitted from TIME’s 2026 ‘Architects of AI’ list, while Paris Hilton makes it
summary: Nvidia and AMD CEOs, key figures in AI infrastructure, are notably absent from TIME's latest AI power list, which includes celebrities like Paris Hilton and Ben Affleck.
details: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and AMD CEO Lisa Su were surprisingly excluded from TIME's 2026 TIME100 AI list. This marks a significant shift, as Huang, previously named an "Architect of AI" and on every prior edition, is now absent.

The list includes unexpected names such as Paris Hilton, Ben Affleck, and Senator Bernie Sanders. Meanwhile, Nvidia's sole representative is Josh Parker, the company's head of sustainability, whose profile focuses on data center energy consumption.
Other tech leaders, including Broadcom CEO Hock Tan and Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra, did make the list. These include Nvidia's HBM supplier, major GPU cloud customers, and custom-accelerator rivals.

TIME editor-in-chief Sam Jacobs stated the list aims to highlight "key storylines" and those "having the most influence." However, previous honorees like Mark Zuckerberg and Sundar Pichai were also omitted from this edition.

The omissions are particularly striking given Huang's and Su's past recognition by TIME, with Su named 2024 CEO of the Year. Nvidia recently reported $96.2 billion in Q2 revenue, with $89 billion from data centers, underscoring their central role in the AI revolution.
